title: Nothing runs outside a region the estate has decided on
why: A resource created in a region nobody watches is a resource with no alarm, no backup policy, no log destination and no residency claim behind it. The failure is silent: it works.
sourced_from: docs/architecture/aws-inventory.json — region: us-east-1, and every resource the inventory found is in it
docs/decisions/ADR-0007-tenure-owned-aws-organization.md — partition awareness; a sovereign deployment is a placement decision, so this list is edited rather than worked around
limits: This constrains where an API CALL lands, not where data ends up: a global service replicating to an edge location is outside its reach.
Adding a region is an edit to allowed_regions AND to the Statement condition below. They are checked against each other by tests/security/scp-guardrails.test.mjs so the two cannot drift.
